::: callout-note
An entry in the table means:

-   **Lectures - watch this and bring in the worksheet**: watch the recorded lectures, do the worksheet, and bring it in to the weekly meeting (i.e. Wednesday, 09:45 am).
-   **Milestones - deliver this:** upload the presentation slide until 10:00 on the Monday before the weekly meeting. Attend the weekly meeting for milestone presentation & discussion.
-   **Workbench:** weekly workbench sessions (i.e., Firday, 11:30) where we talk more about practical EEG processing. For the second half of the semester where there is no workbench scheduled, the sessions are used for individual project meetings.
-   **Practical learning opportunities:** these are the optional exercises that help you better understand the concepts and practice the methods that you are going to apply in your own projects.
:::
